words.sz: 电视的确有一些缺点。

words.d: A country is an area of land with the same government and laws.

words.s: Anything you say may be held against you in a court of law.
words.sz: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

words.s: One thousand dollars will cover all the expenses for the party.
words.sz: 1000美元将负担聚会的全部费用。
words.d: To cover something is to put things over it.

words.s: I don't like being the one who always has to milk the cow.
words.sz: 我不喜欢做那个总是挤牛奶的人。

words.s: His wife is in the hospital because she was injured in a car crash.
words.sz: 他的妻子在醫院裡因為她在一場車禍中受傷了。
words.d: To crash means to hit and break something.

words.s: She created an igloo from blocks of snow.
words.d: To create means to make something new.

words.s: Tom says that he's a creature of habit.
words.sz: 汤姆说他是习惯的产物。
words.d: A creature is an animal or person.

words.s: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
words.sz: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。
words.d: Credit is something good in your favour.

words.s: Modern ships only need a small crew.
words.sz: 現代船隻只需要一小組的船員。
words.d: A crew is a group of workers.

words.s: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.
words.sz: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。
words.d: If someone commits a crime, he or she does something bad that can be punished by law.

words.s: His son's criminal activities caused him great pain.
words.sz: 他儿子的犯罪行为给他带来了很大的痛苦。

words.s: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
words.sz: 在危險的時候你必須跟你的老師聯繫。
words.d: A crisis is a difficult time when things are going to either get worse or better.

words.s: He criticized his wife for spending too much money.
words.d: To criticize is to say bad things about someone or something.

words.s: We grow a variety of crops.
words.sz: 我們種植各種的作物。

words.s: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
words.sz: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。

words.s: I heard someone in the crowd outside the station call my name.
words.sz: 我聽到車站外的人群中有人在叫我的名字。
words.d: A crowd is a large group of people who are together in one place.

words.s: It looks like Tom has a crush on Mary.
words.sz: 看来汤姆热恋着玛丽。
words.d: To crush something is to press it together so its shape is destroyed.

words.s: The moment I held the baby in my arms, it began to cry.
words.sz: 我一把孩子抱在手里，他就开始哭了。

words.s: The students are talking about language and culture.
words.sz: 学生们在探讨语言和文化。
words.d: Culture is the music, art, and writings of a certain place or group of people.

words.s: There aren't any medicines that can cure this disease.
words.sz: 没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。
words.d: A cure is a medical treatment to make a sickness go away.

words.s: An electric current can generate magnetism.
words.sz: 電流可以產生磁性。
words.d: A current is a steady and constant flow of air or water in a river or ocean.

words.s: It is a custom that the bride and groom have the first dance.
words.d: A custom is a way of doing things that has been the same for a long time.

words.s: I was searched by the customs officers at the airport.
words.sz: 我在機場被海關人員搜查。

words.s: He cut it with the knife that he received as a present from his brother.
words.sz: 他用哥哥送給他的刀子切開了。

words.s: This dam supplies us with water and electricity.
words.sz: 这个水坝给我们提供水和电。

words.s: Our employees are working around the clock to fix the damage caused by the ice storm.
words.sz: 我们的员工正在争分夺秒地修理冰暴带来的损坏。
words.d: To damage something is to break it.

words.s: Tom has no intention of asking Mary to the upcoming dance.
words.sz: Tom没有意图去邀请Mary去即将来临的舞会。

words.s: The red flag indicated the presence of danger.
words.sz: 红旗代表存在危险。
words.d: Danger is the possibility that someone or something will be harmed, destroyed, or killed.

words.s: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.
words.sz: 因为闪光灯坏了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。

words.s: The crash was and remains to date the deadliest airplane accident on Canadian soil.
words.sz: 這起空難是迄今為止加拿大境內最嚴重的空難。

words.s: Last month our twenty-year-old daughter gave birth to a baby girl.
words.sz: 上个月，我们20岁的女儿生了个女孩。

words.s: The post office is closed on Christmas day and mail will not be delivered.
words.sz: 聖誕節當天郵局休息，郵件將不予投遞。
words.d: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, beginning at midnight.

words.s: If there was no sun, all the animals would be dead.
words.sz: 如果没有太阳，那所有生物都会死。

words.s: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
words.sz: 善良是聾子能聽盲人能看的語言。
words.d: A deaf person or animal cannot hear.

words.s: If you want to go, then go. If you don't want to, then it's no big deal.
words.sz: 如果你想去，就去好了。如果你不想去，那也没什么大不了的。
words.d: A deal is an agreement that you have with another person.

words.s: He participated in the debate.
words.sz: 他参加辩论
words.d: To debate is to seriously discuss something with someone.

words.s: All you have to do is ask him to pay the debt.
words.sz: 你只需要喊他还债就行。
words.d: A debt is an amount of money that a person owes.

words.s: Now's the time to decide whether you really want to get married or not.
words.sz: 现在是你决定是不是真要结婚的时候。
words.d: To decide is to make a definite choice.

words.s: Do you have anything to declare?
words.sz: 你有任何要申報的東西嗎？
words.d: To declare is to say something officially.

words.s: This medicine will decrease your pain.
words.sz: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。
words.d: To decrease something is to make it less than it was before.

words.s: The baby was in a deep sleep in his mother's arms.
words.sz: 孩子在母亲的怀中熟睡。

words.s: The champion defeated the challenger in the boxing match.
words.d: To defeat someone is to beat that person in a game or battle.

words.s: People define success in many different ways.
words.d: To define means to clearly state, show, or explain what something is.

words.s: He got a master's degree in law.
words.sz: 他得到了法律碩士學位。
words.d: Degree is a unit for measuring temperature.

words.s: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
words.sz: 我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。
words.d: To delay means to wait to do something.

words.s: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
words.sz: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。

words.s: Democracy is the worst form of government, except all the others that have been tried.
words.sz: 除了那些我们尝试过的政府形态，民主是最差的那种了。

words.s: Can you demonstrate it?
words.sz: 您可以示範一下嗎?
words.d: To demonstrate something is to show how it is done.

words.s: We can't deny the fact that he's honest.
words.sz: 我们无法否认，他确实是很诚实的人。

words.s: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
words.sz: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
words.d: To depend on something is to need it for support or help.

words.s: After Tom lost his job, he started to gamble to cope with his depression.
words.sz: 湯姆失業後，為了排遣鬱悶的心情而開始了賭博。
words.d: Depression is a medical condition that makes a person very unhappy for long periods of time.

words.s: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
words.sz: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
words.d: To describe is to say or write what someone or something is like.

words.s: The Sahara is a vast desert.
words.sz: 撒哈拉沙漠广袤无垠。
words.d: The desert is an area of land without many plants or water.

words.s: This design is very ergonomic.
words.sz: 這個設計很人性化。

words.s: There are no people who don't desire peace.
words.sz: 沒人不渴望和平。
words.d: To desire is to want something.

words.s: Destroy this temple.
words.sz: 摧毁这个寺庙。
words.d: To destroy means to damage something so badly that it cannot be used.

words.s: He described the incident in detail.
words.sz: 他詳細地描述了事故狀況。
words.d: A detail is a small piece of information.

words.s: The police had to detain the thief for shoplifting.
words.d: To detain is to officially prevent someone from leaving a place.

words.s: Our country must develop its natural resources.
words.sz: 我們國家必須開發自然資源。
words.d: To develop is to make something larger or more advanced.

words.s: You should have shown him the device.
words.sz: 你应该给他看看这装置。
words.d: A device is an object or a machine.

words.s: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
words.sz: 可憐的人民任憑殘暴的獨裁者處置。

words.s: "The good die young" is an old saying which may or may not be true.
words.sz: “好人不长命”是句或真或假的老话。

words.s: We're going to eat a lot tonight so I hope you're not on a diet.
words.sz: 我们今晚会吃很多，所以我希望你没有在节食。
words.d: A diet is the food regularly eaten by a person.

words.s: When she was in Los Angeles, she had at least six different jobs.
words.sz: 當她在洛杉磯的時候,她至少有六份工作。
words.d: Different describes someone or something that is not the same as others.

words.s: At first, he thought English very difficult, but now he thinks it is easy.
words.sz: 起初他以为英语很难，如今他觉得很简单。

words.s: In 1848, people came to California to dig for gold.
words.sz: 1848年人们来加利福尼亚淘金。
words.d: To dig is to make a hole in the ground.

words.s: You should apologize to your father for not getting home in time for dinner.
words.sz: 你應該為你沒有及時回家吃晚餐向你父親道歉。
words.d: Dinner is the main meal eaten in the evening.

words.s: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.
words.sz: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。
words.d: A diplomat is a representative of a country who works with another country.

words.s: Are there any direct flights between Boston and Sydney?
words.sz: 请问波士顿和悉尼之间有直飞航班吗？
words.d: If something is direct, it goes straight between two places.

words.s: You have a really good sense of direction.
words.sz: 你的方向感很好。
words.d: A direction is the way to go.

words.s: The children were playing in the dirt.
words.sz: 孩子们在尘土里游戏。

words.s: The top of the building is disappearing in the clouds.
words.d: To disappear means to go away or not be seen.

words.s: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.
words.sz: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。
words.d: A disaster is a really bad thing that happens.

words.s: Call me if you discover anything.
words.sz: 如果你發現什麼，請打給我。
words.d: To discover something is to find it for the first time.

words.s: He fought against racial discrimination.
words.sz: 他反对种族歧视。

words.s: There's something I've been meaning to discuss with you.
words.sz: 有件事我一直想跟你商量。
words.d: To discuss is to talk about something with another person.

words.s: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
words.sz: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。
words.d: A disease is an illness that causes specific problems.

words.s: He quickly dismissed my idea about the new project.
words.d: To dismiss something is to say it is not important.

words.s: Karen and Brian often have disputes about silly things.
words.d: A dispute is an argument or disagreement that people have.

words.s: The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
words.sz: 发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。
words.d: A distance is how far it is between two points.

words.s: I like sky-diving from an airplane.
words.d: When you dive into water, you go down head first into the water.

words.s: Let's divide this money between you and me.
words.sz: 这钱你和我分了吧。
words.d: To divide something is to split it into smaller parts.

words.s: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
words.sz: 現在我們什麼也做不了，救不了湯姆。我們唯一能做的就是祈禱。

words.s: The doctor told Mary that she couldn't have any more children.
words.sz: 医生告诉玛丽她不能再要更多孩子了。
words.d: A doctor is a person who studies medicine and helps sick people.

words.s: This document was actually written by Tom.
words.sz: 這文件其實是湯姆寫的。
words.d: A document is a written text, usually not in the form of a book.

words.s: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
words.sz: 忠犬八公的雕像伫立在涩谷站前。
words.d: A dog is an animal with four legs and a tail that is kept as a pet or trained to work.

words.s: This little baby tore up a 10 dollar bill.
words.sz: 這個小嬰孩撕掉了一張十美元的鈔票。

words.s: How much money do you donate every year?
words.sz: 你每年捐多少钱？
words.d: To donate is to give something to a charity or organization.

words.s: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
words.sz: 最合逻輯的放鞋處是門口附近。
words.d: A door is an object that swings or slides open and shut.

words.s: Prices are double what they were ten years ago.
words.sz: 价钱是10年前的2倍。
words.d: Double means twice as much or twice as many.

words.s: Rather than cutting down on cigarettes, why don't you just give them up?
words.sz: 比起少抽菸，你何不直接把菸戒了？

words.s: If you want to hear a scary story, I'll tell you about a dream I had a few weeks ago.
words.sz: 如果你想聽恐怖故事，那我就把幾個星期前作的夢告訴你吧。

words.s: Don't worry! Even if I drink, it doesn't have an effect on my driving.
words.sz: 別擔心!即使我喝酒了,它對我的駕駛沒有影響。
words.d: To drink is to take liquid into the body through the mouth.

words.s: I learned to drive a car and got a driver's license when I was eighteen.
words.sz: 我十八歲時，學了開車、考到了駕照。

words.s: Be sure to drop us a line as soon as you get to London.
words.sz: 别忘了一到伦敦就给我们留言啊。
words.d: To drop is to fall or allow something to fall.

words.s: He would have drowned if the sailors had not rescued him.
words.d: To drown is to die from not being able to breathe underwater.

words.s: The drug problem is international.
words.sz: 毒品是国际性的问题。

words.s: Tom wrung out the towel and hung it up to dry.
words.sz: 汤姆拧干毛巾挂起来晾干。

words.s: Tom returned to his hometown to visit his parents during the summer break.
words.sz: 汤姆在夏休回乡看望父母。
words.d: During an event means while the event was happening.

words.s: Probably you are allergic to pollen or dust.
words.sz: 你可能对花粉或灰尘过敏。
words.d: Dust is very small, dry particles of earth or sand.

words.s: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
words.sz: 暴動開始時只有一位監獄長值班。
words.d: A duty is something that a person has to do.

words.s: A year has passed, but it's as if we saw each other only yesterday.
words.sz: 一年过去了，但仿佛我们昨天还见过面似的。

words.s: Because of the typhoon, my parents ended their trip one day early.
words.sz: 因为台风的关系，我的父母提早一天结束了旅行回到家。

words.s: I wanted to earn some money, so I worked part time three days a week.
words.sz: 我想挣点钱，所以我一周打三天小时工。
words.d: To earn means to get money for the work you do.

words.s: What do you think would happen if the earth stopped spinning?
words.sz: 如果地球停止自传，你认为会发生什么？

words.s: A couple of flights were delayed on account of the earthquake.
words.sz: 一些航班由於地震被延誤了。
words.d: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of a part of the Earth’s surface that often causes a lot of damage.

words.s: I am very ill at ease with strangers.
words.sz: 我面对陌生人很不自在。
words.d: Ease is a condition without difficulty or hard work.

words.s: The sun comes up in the east and goes down in the west.
words.sz: 太阳从东边升起，西边落下。
words.d: East is the direction the sun rises from.

words.s: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
words.sz: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。
words.d: An easy action is not difficult to do.

words.s: Many parents think it's important for their children to eat before 8:00 p.m.
words.sz: 許多父母認為讓自己的子女在下午八點前吃完飯是很重要的。
words.d: To eat is to chew and swallow food.

words.s: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.
words.sz: 她开始对生态学感兴趣，是受到他的影响。
words.d: Ecology is the study of the environment and living things.

words.s: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
words.sz: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。
words.d: An economy is the money and businesses of a country or region.

words.s: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
words.sz: 如果系统工程师继续离开，公司的竞争优势将会被削弱。
words.d: The edge is the furthest part or side of something.

words.s: He always left the problem of his children's education to his wife.
words.sz: 他總是把孩子的教育問題留給他的妻子。
words.d: Education is the process of teaching and learning, usually at a school, college, or university.

words.s: Don't worry! Even if I drink, it doesn't have an effect on my driving.
words.sz: 別擔心!即使我喝酒了,它對我的駕駛沒有影響。
words.d: An effect is a change made by something else.

words.s: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
words.sz: 已經花費了很多的時間和精力。
words.d: Effort is hard work or an attempt to do something.

words.s: Tom doesn't even know how to fry an egg.
words.sz: 汤姆甚至连怎么煎鸡蛋都不知道。

words.s: We don't like our neighbors, and they don't like us, either.
words.sz: 我們不喜歡我們的鄰居，而他們也不喜歡我們。

words.s: Austria is one of the largest producers of electricity in Europe.
words.sz: 澳大利亚在欧洲是最大的电能生产国之一。

words.s: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.
words.sz: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。

words.s: Some doctors say that what a mother eats has a big effect on her embryo.
words.d: An embryo is a human or animal that is still growing inside its mother.

words.s: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
words.sz: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
words.d: An emergency is a time when someone needs help right away.

words.s: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
words.sz: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。
words.d: An emotion is how you feel.

words.s: The bookstore employed two full-time clerks.
words.d: To employ someone means to give work to them.

words.s: There are three empty rooms. However, we can't use any of them.
words.sz: 虽然有三间空屋，但哪间都用不了。
words.d: An empty container is one that has no things in it.

words.s: Nobody noticed that she was absent until the end of the meeting.
words.sz: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。
words.d: To end is to stop or finish.

words.s: All of a sudden, the enemy bombs came down on us like rain.
words.sz: 突然，敵人的炸彈像雨點一樣落向我們。
words.d: An enemy is a country that is fighting another country during a war.

words.s: A growing child who doesn't seem to have much energy perhaps needs medical attention.
words.sz: 一个成长中的孩子如果没有充足的能量，可能需要药物治疗。
words.d: If you have a lot of energy, you have plenty of strength and can do lots of things.

words.s: Police enforce traffic laws to keep everyone safe.
words.d: To enforce means to make a person follow a rule.

words.s: Keep the engine running. I'll be right back.
words.sz: 讓引擎持續運轉，我去去就來。

words.s: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
words.sz: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
words.d: To engineer something is to skillfully plan out how to make that thing.

words.s: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
words.sz: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
words.d: To enjoy is to like something.

words.s: I had to cancel that order because we didn't have enough money to pay for it.
words.sz: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。

words.s: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.
words.sz: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。
words.d: To enter a place is to go into it.

words.s: Keeping our environment clean is important to our health.
words.d: The environment is the place where people work or live.

words.s: Cutting a cake into equal pieces is rather difficult.
words.sz: 均分蛋糕有些難度。
words.d: When something is equal, it is the same in size, number, amount, or value as something else.

words.s: Keep away from the electrical equipment.
words.sz: 遠離電器設備。
words.d: Equipment consists of the things which are used for a specific purpose.

words.s: He looked for every possible means of escape.
words.sz: 他寻找一切可能的逃生途径。
words.d: If you escape from a place, you succeed in getting away from it.

words.s: I like to listen to music, especially jazz.
words.sz: 我喜歡聽音樂，特別是爵士音樂。

words.s: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
words.sz: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。
words.d: To establish something means to create it.

words.s: How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?
words.sz: 你估计做那件事需要花费你多少时间呢？
words.d: To estimate something means to make a guess about it.

words.s: Many sections of the city are home to different ethnic communities.
words.d: If something is ethnic, then it is related to a group with a similar culture.

words.s: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.
words.sz: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。

words.s: On the whole, the event was successful.
words.sz: 整體而言，這個事件是成功的。
words.d: An event is something that happens, especially something important.

words.s: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
words.sz: 你看過富士山嗎?它美得無法形容。
words.d: Ever means at any time.

words.s: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.
words.sz: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。

words.s: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.
words.sz: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。
words.d: Evidence is a fact or thing that you use to prove something.

words.s: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
words.sz: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。
words.d: Evil describes something or someone bad or cruel, not good.

words.s: Can you explain the exact meaning of this word?
words.sz: 你能否說出這個詞的精確意思?
words.d: Exact means correct in every detail.

words.s: Dentists take X-rays to examine your teeth.
words.sz: 牙医用X光检查你的牙齿。
words.d: To examine something is to look at it carefully.

words.s: You should set a good example for your children.
words.sz: 你应该给你的孩子们树立好榜样。
words.d: An example of something is a thing that is typical of it.

words.s: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
words.sz: 他是一位優秀的科學家，更是一位偉大的詩人。
words.d: When something is excellent, it is very good.

words.s: Democracy is the worst form of government, except all the others that have been tried.
words.sz: 除了那些我们尝试过的政府形态，民主是最差的那种了。

words.s: The company went public and became listed on the stock exchange in 1990.
words.sz: 该公司于1990年挂牌上市。
words.d: To exchange is to give one thing in return for another.

words.s: Excuse me, but could you tell me how to get to Central Park?
words.sz: 不好意思，請問到中央公園要怎麼走?

words.s: We must execute his orders.
words.sz: 我们必须执行他的命令。
words.d: To execute means to kill someone as a legal punishment.

words.s: The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.
words.sz: 最好的減肥方法就是少吃多運動。
words.d: To exercise is to run or play sports so that you can be healthy.

words.s: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
words.sz: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。
words.d: To exist is to be real.

words.s: A balloon will expand as you blow air into it.
words.d: To expand is to become bigger in size.

words.s: We did not expect him to finish the task in so short a time.
words.sz: 我们没指望过他在那么短的时间里完成工作。
words.d: If you expect something to happen, you believe it will happen.

words.s: Since he would not follow the rules, the principal had to expel the student.
words.d: To expel someone means to force them to leave a place.

words.s: His intelligence and experience enabled him to deal with the trouble.
words.sz: 他的智慧和經驗使他能處理這個麻煩。
words.d: To experience is to do or see something or have something happen to you.

words.s: Three months is too short a time to finish the experiment.
words.sz: 要完成实验，三个月太短了。
words.d: An experiment is a test that you do to see what will happen.

words.s: Even expert drivers can make mistakes.
words.sz: 再怎麼經驗老到的司機都會出錯。
words.d: An expert is someone who is very good at doing something.

words.s: It would take me too much time to explain to you why it's not going to work.
words.sz: 给你解释这为什么行不通要花很多时间。

words.s: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.
words.sz: 一点火花让火药爆炸。
words.d: To explode is to suddenly move apart in many smaller pieces.

words.s: He wants to explore the world and see new things.
words.d: To explore is to look for new places.

words.s: The United States exports many cereals and grains.
words.d: To export products means to sell them to other countries.

words.s: I'd like to know the phone number of the nearest American Express office.
words.sz: 我想知道最近的美國運通辦事處的電話號碼。
words.d: To express a feeling or idea means to show others how one thinks or feels.

words.s: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.
words.sz: 我想延长这里的住宿多几天。

words.s: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
words.sz: 我太太兼職的工作賺進了一些額外的錢。
words.d: If something is extra, it is more than what is needed.

words.s: Tom is an extraordinary man.
words.sz: 汤姆是个不寻常的人。
words.d: Extraordinary things are amazing.

words.s: Your proposal is a bit extreme.
words.sz: 你的建議有點極端。

words.s: Tom wouldn't dare show his face around here again.
words.sz: 汤姆不敢再到这里露面。
words.d: To face is to deal with something in a direct way.

words.s: As a matter of fact, I haven't eaten anything since this morning.
words.sz: 事實上，我從今天早上開始沒有吃任何東西。
words.d: A fact is a piece of information that is true.

words.s: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
words.sz: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。
words.d: A factory is a building where things are made or put together.

words.s: That kind of person will definitely fail.
words.sz: 这种人注定惨败。
words.d: To fail means you do not succeed in what you try to do.

words.s: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
words.sz: 把你的失败归咎于你的父母是不对的。
words.d: Fair means reasonable or right.

words.s: Manholes are round because that way they won't accidentally fall through the hole.
words.sz: 人孔是圓的，因為這樣人孔蓋就不會意外地掉進洞裡。

words.s: The truth is that nothing is totally true or false.
words.sz: 真相是沒有甚麼完全正確或錯誤。
words.d: If something is false, it is not correct.

words.s: We must take into account the wishes of all the family in planning a trip.
words.sz: 筹划旅行的时候，我们必须考虑到全家人的意愿。
words.d: A family is a group of people who are related to each other.

words.s: I like this picture, not just because it's famous, but because it really is a masterpiece.
words.sz: 我喜欢这幅画，不仅是因为它的名气，而是因为它真的是一个杰作。
words.d: A famous person or thing is well known.

words.s: Does any other country fan the flames of patriotism as much as America?
words.sz: 有没有一个国家比美国更提倡爱国主义？

words.s: Our task has been easy so far, but it will be difficult from now on.
words.sz: 我们的任务到目前为止很轻松，但从现在开始将会变得很难。
words.d: If something is far, it is not close.

words.s: I've never lived on a farm, but both of my parents grew up on farms.
words.sz: 我從沒有在農場住，但我的父母都在農場長大。

words.s: The professor spoke too fast for anyone to understand.
words.sz: 那个教授讲得太快了，没有一个人听得懂。
words.d: To fast means to go without food or drink for a period of time.

words.s: Were you fat when you were in high school?
words.sz: 你在高中的时候胖吗？
words.d: Fat is an oily solid or liquid substance in food.

words.s: You should apologize to your father for not getting home in time for dinner.
words.sz: 你應該為你沒有及時回家吃晚餐向你父親道歉。

words.s: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
words.sz: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。

words.s: Do not fear the unexpected, but be prepared for it.
words.sz: 不要害怕意外，但要有準備。
words.d: Fear is the feeling of being afraid.

words.s: Sometimes federal laws are different from state laws.
words.d: If something is federal, it relates to the government of a country.

words.s: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
words.sz: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

words.s: They told me that I would feel a little better if I took this medicine.
words.sz: 他們告訴我吃完這個藥我就會覺得舒服一點。
words.d: To feel is to experience an emotion or feeling.

words.s: I have three dogs. One is male and the other two are female.
words.sz: 我有三只狗，其中一只是公的，另外两只是母的。
words.d: Female refers to women or girls.

words.s: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
words.sz: 花园被木栅栏围了起来。

words.s: The farmer grew many vegetables in the fertile soil.
words.d: Fertile land is able to produce good crops and plants.

words.s: She recognized the brooch as the one she had lost a few months before.
words.sz: 她认出那枚胸针是她几个月前丢失的。
words.d: A few things is a small number of them.

words.s: Field hockey is not very popular in China.
words.sz: 曲棍球在中国不是很流行。
words.d: A field is a subject that people study or an area of activity that they are involved in as part of their work.

words.s: Wolves are fierce animals. Do not disturb them.
words.d: A fierce person or animal is angry or violent.

words.s: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.
words.sz: 一名伟大的战士威力显著，无需抵死奋战。

words.s: Be sure to fill out the registration form in person.
words.sz: 确保亲自填写注册表格。

words.s: There isn't any film in this camera.
words.sz: 這箇相機裡沒有膠片。

words.s: We left the final decision to him.
words.sz: 我們讓他做最後的決定。
words.d: If something is final, it is the last part.

words.s: Russia is facing great financial difficulties.
words.sz: 俄罗斯面临着严重的财政困难。

words.s: By the way, did you find the umbrella you said you'd lost the other day?
words.sz: 对了，前些时间你说伞不见了，现在找到了吗？

words.s: If it rains on that day, the game will be postponed until the next fine day.
words.sz: 如果那天下雨，比赛会顺延至下一个晴天。

words.s: We probably don't have enough time to finish doing that today.
words.sz: 我们应该不够时间在今天之内完成它。

words.s: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
words.sz: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

words.s: We enjoyed watching the fireworks on a bridge last summer.
words.sz: 去年夏天，我们在桥上看焰火看得很过瘾。
words.d: Fireworks are objects that create colored lights when they are lit.

words.s: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
words.sz: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。
words.d: A firm thing is solid but not too hard.

words.s: At first, he thought English very difficult, but now he thinks it is easy.
words.sz: 起初他以为英语很难，如今他觉得很简单。

words.s: It's better to teach someone how to fish than to give someone a fish.
words.sz: 授之以鱼，不如授之以渔。

words.s: There were no hats in that store that fit me.
words.sz: 那個店裡沒有合我尺寸的帽子。

words.s: Our employees are working around the clock to fix the damage caused by the ice storm.
words.sz: 我们的员工正在争分夺秒地修理冰暴带来的损坏。
words.d: To fix something is to make it work.

words.s: The colors of the American flag are red, white and blue.
words.sz: 美国国旗的颜色是红白蓝。
words.d: A flag is a piece of colored cloth that represents something.

words.s: My bicycle has a flat tire.
words.sz: 我的腳踏車輪胎沒氣了。
words.d: Flat describes something that is level and smooth with no curved parts.

words.s: When a predator approaches a deer, the deer will flee.
words.d: To flee is to leave somewhere very quickly in order to escape from danger.

words.s: Oil will float on water.
words.sz: 油漂浮在水上。
words.d: To float is to move on top of water without sinking.

words.s: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
words.sz: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。
words.d: A flood is an event in which water covers an area that is usually dry.

words.s: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

words.s: The water flowed over the rocks and into the lake.
words.d: To flow is to move easily and continuously in one direction.

words.s: The bathtub was filled with hot water and flower petals.
words.sz: 浴缸裡滿是熱水和花瓣。
words.d: A flower is the colored part of a plant.

words.s: Boris was a famous ballet dancer because people admired his fluid movements.
words.d: If something is fluid, it is smooth and moves gracefully.

words.s: He is afraid to fly in an airplane.
words.sz: 他怕坐飞机。

words.s: London, where I live, used to be famous for its fog.
words.sz: 我住的地方－倫敦，從前以霧聞名。
words.d: Fog is a thick cloud that is near the ground or water.

words.s: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
words.sz: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。

words.s: When his food supply ran short, he had to look for a new place to live.
words.sz: 他的食物供给不足的的时候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。
words.d: Food is things people and animals eat.

words.s: That's nonsense. Nobody but a fool would believe it.
words.sz: 那是無稽之談。只有傻瓜才會相信。

words.s: "How long does it take to get to Vienna on foot?" he inquired.
words.sz: “步行到Vienon需要多少时间？”他问。

words.s: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

words.s: I will never force you to marry him.
words.sz: 我永遠不會逼你跟他結婚。
words.d: Force is a person’s strength or power.

words.s: You seem to be prejudiced against ideas that come from foreign countries.
words.sz: 你似乎對來自國外的想法有偏見。
words.d: Something foreign is something we are not used to.

words.s: She slowly disappeared into the foggy forest.
words.sz: 她緩緩消失在霧氣瀰漫的森林中。

words.s: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.
words.sz: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。

words.s: Tom is never going to forgive me, is he?
words.sz: 汤姆永远也不会原谅我了，是吗？
words.d: To forgive someone is to stop being angry with them.

words.s: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
words.sz: 線條藝術強調形式和輪廓，而不是顏色、陰影和紋理。
words.d: To form is to make or to shape something.

words.s: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
words.sz: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。
words.d: Former describes something that used to be but is not anymore.

words.s: We are all looking forward to seeing you and your family.
words.sz: 我们都期待看到你和你的家人。
words.d: If you move forward, you move in the direction in front of you.

words.s: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
words.sz: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。

words.s: Freedom is the center of American democracy.
words.sz: 美國民主的中心思想是自由。

words.s: It may freeze next week.
words.sz: 下周可能会结冰。

words.s: Fresh fruits and vegetables are good for your health.
words.sz: 新鮮水果和蔬菜有益健康。

words.s: "Where have you been?" "I have been to the station to see a friend off."
words.sz: “你去哪儿了？”“我去了火车站送我的一个朋友。”
words.d: A friend is someone a person knows and likes spending time with.

words.s: Scary movies will frighten the children.
words.sz: 恐怖片會嚇到小孩。

words.s: After he had graduated from the university, he taught English for two years.
words.sz: 從他大學畢業以後,他教了兩年的英語。
words.d: From shows a starting place or position.

words.s: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

words.s: I found a good place to buy fruit a couple of days ago.
words.sz: 前几天我发现了一个买水果的好地方。
words.d: Fruit is a type of healthy food that grows on trees and plants.

words.s: The fuel tank in the car is full.
words.sz: 汽車油箱是滿的。
words.d: Fuel is something that creates heat or energy.

words.s: She took full advantage of her stay in London to improve her English.
words.sz: 她充分利用她住在伦敦的优势，提高英语。

words.s: It's fun to learn slang words in foreign languages.
words.sz: 学习外语里的俚语很有趣。
words.d: When something is fun, it is enjoyable.

words.s: At lunchtime today, our usual restaurant was closed because of a funeral in the family.
words.sz: 今天午餐時間，我們常去的飯館關門了，因為他們家在辦喪事。
words.d: A funeral is a ceremony that takes place after a person dies.

words.s: I really look forward to your visit in the near future.
words.sz: 我很期待在不久的將來您的光臨。

words.s: They tried very hard to gain an advantage over one another.
words.sz: 他們很努力地超過對方獲得優勢。
words.d: To gain is to gradually get more and more of a quality, feeling, etc.

words.s: If it rains on that day, the game will be postponed until the next fine day.
words.sz: 如果那天下雨，比赛会顺延至下一个晴天。
words.d: A game is an activity where people compete against each other.

words.s: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
words.sz: 這場爆炸有可能是瓦斯外洩引起的。

words.s: I gather that they'll agree with us.
words.sz: 我猜想他們會同意我們的。
words.d: To gather is to form a group or bring together.

words.s: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
words.sz: 一般來說，消费者喜歡數量勝於質量。

words.s: My parents' generation went through the war.
words.sz: 我父母那一代经历过战争。
words.d: A generation is a group of people who live at the same time.

words.s: As a result of the genocide, many children have been orphaned.
words.d: Genocide is the deliberate murder of a whole group or race of people.

words.s: She gave the door a gentle push.
words.sz: 她輕輕地推了門。
words.d: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm.

words.s: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.
words.sz: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。

words.s: Tom asked Mary to buy a gift for John.
words.sz: 汤姆叫玛丽买一份礼物给约翰。
words.d: A gift is something you give someone.

words.s: Last month our twenty-year-old daughter gave birth to a baby girl.
words.sz: 上个月，我们20岁的女儿生了个女孩。

words.s: Rather than cutting down on cigarettes, why don't you just give them up?
words.sz: 比起少抽菸，你何不直接把菸戒了？

words.s: In case of fire, break the glass and push the red button.
words.sz: 万一发生火灾，打碎玻璃并按下红色按钮。
words.d: Glass is a transparent, breakable material.

words.s: If you want to go, then go. If you don't want to, then it's no big deal.
words.sz: 如果你想去，就去好了。如果你不想去，那也没什么大不了的。

words.s: He never gave up hope that he would reach that goal.
words.sz: 他從沒放棄達成那個目標的希望。
words.d: A goal is something you work toward.

words.s: According to the Bible, God created the world in six days.
words.sz: 根据圣经记载，上帝用6天创造了世界。

words.s: In 1848, people came to California to dig for gold.
words.sz: 1848年人们来加利福尼亚淘金。

words.s: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
words.sz: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。

words.s: The police have been searching for the stolen goods for almost a month.
words.sz: 警察大概从一个月前就开始找被偷物品了。
words.d: Goods are anything that can be bought or sold.

words.s: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
words.sz: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

words.s: There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.
words.sz: 他说的话全不可信。
words.d: A grain is a food crop such as wheat, corn, rice, or oats.

words.s: Cows are eating grass in the meadow.
words.sz: 牛在草地上吃牧草。
words.d: Grass is the green leaves that cover the ground.

words.s: My office is on the fourth floor of that gray six-story building.
words.sz: 我的办公室在那幢灰色的六层楼的四楼。

words.s: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.
words.sz: 一名伟大的战士威力显著，无需抵死奋战。
words.d: When something is great, it is very good.

words.s: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
words.sz: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
words.d: Green is the color of growing grass or leaves.

words.s: We grind wheat to make flour.
words.d: To grind is to break something into small pieces or powder.

words.s: The house burned to the ground before the fire truck arrived.
words.sz: 消防车到达之前，房子就全烧了。

words.s: I saw a group of foreigners on my way to school this morning.
words.sz: 今天早上在去学校的路上，我看到了一群外国人。

words.s: They grow strawberries in their greenhouse.
words.sz: 他們在他們的溫室裡種植草莓。

words.s: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.
words.sz: 我不能确保这一切会发生。
words.d: I will guarantee that the loan will be repaid.

words.s: Don't let your guard down.
words.sz: 不要放松警惕。
words.d: To guard something is to take care of it.

words.s: Tom has a guide dog named Cookie.
words.sz: 湯姆有一隻導盲犬，名叫曲奇。
words.d: A guide is someone who shows you where to go.

words.s: If he is innocent, it follows that his wife is guilty.
words.sz: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。
words.d: Guilty people feel bad for something they did.

words.s: Tom said that he keeps a gun in his home.
words.sz: 湯姆說他的家裡有把槍。

words.s: Blondes earn 7% more than women with any other hair color.
words.sz: 金髮女郎比其他顏色頭髮的女人多賺7％。

words.s: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
words.sz: 婚前張開眼，婚後半閉眼。
words.d: If you cut something into two parts that are the same size, you cut it half.

words.s: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
words.sz: 当列车停止时，所有的乘客都想知道发生了什么。

words.sz: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。

words.sz: 山上的老教堂的歷史可以追溯到12世紀。

words.sz: 人孔是圓的，因為這樣人孔蓋就不會意外地掉進洞裡。

words.s: You've worked hard for months and have certainly earned a holiday.

words.sz: 你應該為你沒有及時回家吃晚餐向你父親道歉。

words.sz: 我枪杀了那匹马，因为他已呼吸困难。

words.s: His wife is in the hospital because she was injured in a car crash.

words.s: We were happy to move away from our hostile neighbor.

words.sz: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。

words.sz: 她僱了一個私人偵探看守她的丈夫。

words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

words.sz: 我们的员工正在争分夺秒地修理冰暴带来的损坏。

words.sz: 自來水有可能含有氯、鉛等有害物質。

words.s: I was planning on going to the beach today, but then it started to rain.
words.sz: 我本来预备今天去海滩的，但接着天就开始下雨了。

words.s: The only useful answers are those that raise new questions.
words.sz: 只有能提出新问题的回答才是有用的回答。

words.s: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.
words.sz: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。

words.s: The unemployment rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September of 2015.
words.sz: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。
words.d: A rate is the speed at which something happens.

words.s: In the U.S., most people can vote when they reach eighteen years of age.
words.sz: 在美國，大多數人能在十八歲以後投票。

words.s: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.
words.sz: 如果有人激怒你，你最好不要立刻做出反应。
words.d: To react is to respond by acting in a certain way.

words.s: The book that I'm planning to read next weekend is in French.
words.sz: 我打算下週閱讀的書是法語寫的。

words.s: The cake should just about be ready to be taken out of the oven.
words.sz: 蛋糕應該差不多可以出爐了。

words.s: Problems that can be solved with money are not real problems.
words.sz: 錢可以解決的問題都不是問題。
words.d: If something is real, it actually exists.

words.s: Let's be realistic.
words.sz: 現實點吧。
words.d: When something is realistic, it is shown as it is in real life.

words.s: If for some reason they come early, please tell them to wait.
words.sz: 如果他们由于什么原因早到的话，请转达他们再等一会儿。
words.d: A reason is a statement or fact that explains why something is the way it is, or why someone does, thinks, or says something.

words.s: Tom bought this camera for a reasonable price.
words.sz: Tom用合理的價格買了相機。

words.s: The rebel was angry about the government’s unfair policies.
words.d: A rebel is a person who fights the government in order to change it.

words.s: Please send me a reply as soon as you receive this mail.
words.sz: 收到此邮件后请尽快给我答复。
words.d: To receive something is to get it.

words.s: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
words.sz: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。
words.d: When something is recent, it happened a short time ago.

words.s: You have changed so much that I can hardly recognize you.
words.sz: 你变了那么多，以至于我几乎认不出你了。
words.d: To recognize something is to know it because you have seen it before.

words.s: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
words.sz: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界紀錄。

words.s: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
words.sz: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？

words.s: Tom rolled up his trouser legs, making his bright red socks visible.
words.sz: 湯姆捲起褲管，露出鮮紅的襪子。
words.d: Red is the color of blood.

words.s: I have to reduce my expenses this month.
words.sz: 我这个月要减少开支。
words.d: To reduce something means to make it smaller in size or fewer in number.

words.s: He proposed a reform in the educational system.
words.sz: 他提议对教育系统进行改革。

words.s: I do not know whether to accept or to refuse.
words.sz: 我不知道是否該同意或拒絕。
words.d: To refuse something is to say “no” to it.

words.s: Could you please sign the register?
words.sz: 請您在登記冊上簽名好嗎？
words.d: A register is an official list or record of people or things.

words.s: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
words.sz: 我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。
words.d: To regret something is to wish that it hadn’t happened.

words.s: I’m afraid the teacher will reject my new idea.
words.d: To reject is to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

words.s: Don't release that prisoner.
words.sz: 別放了那箇犯人。
words.d: To release something is to stop holding it.

words.s: I am interested in Chinese religion.
words.sz: 我对中国宗教感兴趣。
words.d: A religion is a belief in a god or gods.

words.s: Please remain seated for a few minutes.
words.sz: 请坐一会。
words.d: To remain somewhere is to stay there.

words.s: The crash was and remains to date the deadliest airplane accident on Canadian soil.
words.sz: 這起空難是迄今為止加拿大境內最嚴重的空難。

words.s: We were talking about something at that time, but I don't remember what.
words.sz: 我们那时在谈论事情，但我不记得是什么了。

words.s: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.
words.sz: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。
words.d: To remove something is to take it away.

words.s: I will only buy the car if they repair the brakes first.
words.sz: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。
words.d: To repair something is to fix it.

words.s: Could you please repeat what you just said?
words.sz: 您可以再重复一遍刚才说的话吗？

words.s: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
words.sz: 在明天前完成报告几乎是不可能的。
words.d: A report is something someone writes for school or work.

words.s: The blue lines on the map represent rivers.
words.sz: 地图上的蓝线代表河流。
words.d: To represent is to speak or act for a person or group.

words.s: We are sorry we are unable to accept your request.
words.sz: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。

words.s: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
words.sz: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。
words.d: To require something is to say that it is necessary.

words.s: I'm going to help you rescue Tom.
words.sz: 我要幫你營救湯姆。
words.d: To rescue someone means to remove them from danger.

words.s: If we knew what we were doing, it wouldn't be called research, would it?
words.sz: 如果我们知道我们在做什么，那么这不能称之为研究，是吗？
words.d: Research is close and careful study to discover new things.

words.s: You should do the honorable thing and resign.
words.sz: 你應該光榮地辭職。
words.d: To resign means to quit a job.

words.s: I can't resist sweet things.
words.sz: 我抵抗不了甜食的诱惑。
words.d: To resist something is to fight against it.

words.s: My New Year's resolution is to learn how to play the ocarina.
words.sz: 我新年的願望是學會吹奧卡利納塤。
words.d: A resolution is a personal decision.

words.s: The poor man didn’t have the resources to feed himself.
words.d: Resources are a person’s or country’s money and materials that they can use.

words.s: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.
words.sz: 尊重法律是我們社會的基礎。

words.s: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
words.sz: 船长要为乘客安全负责。
words.d: A responsible person is in charge of someone or something.

words.s: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
words.sz: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。
words.d: To rest is to stop being active while the body gets back its strength.

words.s: Tom began to sing "Happy Birthday" and the entire restaurant joined in.
words.sz: 汤姆开始唱“祝你生日快乐”，然后整个餐厅的人都加入了进来。
words.d: A restaurant is a business where people sit and eat food.

words.s: Mike restrained Allen from reaching the door.
words.d: To restrain someone or something means to use physical strength to stop them.

words.s: The club restricted the amount of members.
words.d: To restrict something is to limit it and prevent it from getting bigger.

words.s: Whether he comes or not, the result will be the same.
words.sz: 他来还是不来，结果是一样的。
words.d: A result happens because of something else.

words.s: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.
words.sz: 我希望在六十歲時退休。
words.d: To retire is to leave a job, usually because of old age.

words.s: Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.
words.sz: 汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。

words.s: Tsunamis swept through rice fields and flooded the towns.
words.sz: 海嘯席捲稻田,淹沒了城鎮。

words.s: A person views things differently according to whether they are rich or poor.
words.sz: 每一個人對事情的看法不同是依據他們是富有還是貧窮。

words.s: Apart from on rainy days, I always ride my bike to work.
words.sz: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。
words.d: To ride something is to travel on it. You can ride an animal, a bike, etc.

words.s: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
words.sz: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。

words.s: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
words.sz: 暴動開始時只有一位監獄長值班。
words.d: A riot is a crowd that reacts to bad news by violently breaking laws.

words.s: Even if the sun were to rise in the west, I would not change my mind.
words.sz: 即使太阳从西边出来，我也不会改变主意。

words.s: It's a risk that Tom and I aren't willing to take.
words.sz: 我和汤姆都不愿意冒这个险。
words.d: A risk is a chance of something bad happening.

words.s: Tom went swimming in the river, but when he got out, his clothes had been stolen.
words.sz: 汤姆去河里游泳，但当他出来时，他的衣服被偷了。

words.s: Many accidents resulted from the icy conditions of the road.
words.sz: 道路结冰导致了很多起事故。

words.s: Tom and his friends planned to rob a bank.
words.sz: 湯姆和好友打算搶銀行。
words.d: To rob is to take property by using force.

words.s: Which do you like better, rock music or classical music?
words.sz: 你比較喜歡哪一個，搖滾樂還是古典音樂？
words.d: A rock is a hard thing in the dirt.

words.s: The rocket was launched into space.
words.sz: 火箭發射進入太空。

words.s: He was absent at roll call.
words.sz: 他在点名时缺席。

words.s: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
words.sz: 请在两点半参加在二楼会议室的会议。

words.s: Money is the root of all evil.
words.sz: 金錢是一切罪惡之源。

words.s: I told her not to let go of the rope, but she did.
words.sz: 我叫她不要松开绳子，但是她做了。

words.s: The rough ground hurt my feet.
words.d: A rough thing is not even or smooth.

words.s: Manholes are round because that way they won't accidentally fall through the hole.
words.sz: 人孔是圓的，因為這樣人孔蓋就不會意外地掉進洞裡。

words.s: Can you rub my back?
words.sz: 幫我搓一下背好嗎？
words.d: To rub something is to push on it and move your hand back and forth.

words.s: I think exams ruin education.
words.sz: 我认为考试破坏教育。
words.d: To ruin something means to harm or damage it greatly.

words.s: I make it a rule not to watch television after nine o'clock.
words.sz: 我规定自己在九点之后不看电视。
words.d: A rule is an official instruction that says how things must be done or what is allowed.

words.s: The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
words.sz: 这场减价活动会持续三天，从今天开始。

words.s: I want to live in a small house in a rural area.
words.d: If a place is rural, it is in the countryside instead of the city.

words.s: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
words.sz: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？
words.d: To sacrifice is to give up something in order to get something you want or do something else for someone.

words.s: I can't decide if I'm happy or sad.
words.sz: 我无法确定我是高兴还是难过。

words.s: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
words.sz: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。

words.s: Tom is teaching me to how to sail.
words.sz: 汤姆正在教我怎么开帆船。

words.s: She discovered that she had run out of salt.
words.sz: 她发现她已经断盐了。

words.s: If two men always have the same opinion, one of them is unnecessary.
words.sz: 如果两个人总是意见相同，那么他们其中一个就没必要了。

words.s: The old man loaded his mule with bags full of sand.
words.sz: 老人在骡子的背上放上了一个个装满了沙的袋子。

words.s: The moon is the earth's only satellite.
words.sz: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。
words.d: A satellite is a machine sent into space to get information.

words.s: It is difficult to satisfy everyone.
words.sz: 众口难调。
words.d: To satisfy someone means to make that person happy.

words.s: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
words.sz: 現在我們什麼也做不了，救不了湯姆。我們唯一能做的就是祈禱。
words.d: To save something is to keep it from being hurt.

words.s: They say you shouldn't take rumors seriously, but that's easier said than done.
words.sz: 人们常说不要乱相信谣言，但说起来容易做起来难。

words.s: Outside the school, she saw people with no homes living in cardboard boxes.
words.sz: 她在校外見到沒家的人住紙板箱。
words.d: A school is a place where children go to learn.

words.s: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.
words.sz: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。

words.s: I used to go swimming in the sea when I was a child.
words.sz: 童年时我会去海里游泳。

words.s: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
words.sz: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。
words.d: To search for something or someone means to look for them carefully.

words.s: According to the weather forecast, the rainy season will set in next week.
words.sz: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。
words.d: A season is a time of the year: spring, summer, fall, or winter.

words.s: Tom put the large picnic basket on the passenger seat next to him.
words.sz: 汤姆把那个大野餐篮子放在他旁边的乘客座位上。

words.s: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
words.sz: 请在两点半参加在二楼会议室的会议。

words.s: This is a secret just between you and me, so don't let it slip out.
words.sz: 这只是你和我之间的秘密，所以不要让它流出去。
words.d: A secret is something that you do not tell other people.

words.s: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
words.sz: 德国在1880年代采取了一种社会保障制度。

words.s: Everyone held their breath to see who would win the presidential election.
words.sz: 所有人都屏住呼吸关注着谁会赢得总统竞选。
words.d: To see is to use your eyes to look at something or someone.

words.s: I planted the seed in the dirt, hoping that it would grow into a tree.
words.d: A seed is the hard part of a plant or fruit that trees grow from.

words.s: You need to seek help.
words.sz: 你需要尋求協助。
words.d: To seek is to look for something.

words.s: You seem to be prejudiced against ideas that come from foreign countries.
words.sz: 你似乎對來自國外的想法有偏見。

words.s: The man seized as much money as he could before anyone could see him.
words.d: To seize something means to grab it quickly or strongly.

words.s: Strawberries sell for a high price in the winter.
words.sz: 草莓在冬天售價高。
words.d: To sell is to give something to someone in exchange for money.

words.s: Everybody liked Caroline and chose her to speak for them in the senate.
words.d: A senate is a part of the government in some countries.

words.s: Tom wrote Mary a long letter, but he didn't send it to her.
words.sz: 汤姆给玛丽写了封长信，可是没有寄给她。

words.s: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
words.sz: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。
words.d: To sense something is to know about it without being told.

words.s: Will you please explain the meaning of this sentence to me?
words.sz: 您能为我解释这句句子的意思吗？
words.d: A sentence is punishment given to someone who didn’t follow the law.

words.s: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
words.sz: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。
words.d: If two things are separate, they are not together.

words.s: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
words.sz: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。

words.s: I don't think I've ever made any serious mistakes.
words.sz: 我认为我没犯任何严重的错误。

words.s: It's better to chill white wine before you serve it.
words.sz: 在你侍酒前最好先將白葡萄酒冷卻一下。
words.d: To serve someone is to give them food or drinks.

words.s: I had to wait 20 minutes on the phone before reaching the customer service rep.
words.sz: 我不得不在電話裡等了20分鐘才聯繫到客服代表。
words.d: Service is the act of helping or serving someone.

words.s: According to the weather forecast, the rainy season will set in next week.
words.sz: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。
words.d: To set something is to put it somewhere.

words.s: We settled the argument by looking up the answer on the web.
words.d: When you settle something, you reach an agreement.

words.s: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.
words.sz: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。
words.d: Several is more than two but not many.

words.s: Japan is confronted with severe economic problems.
words.sz: 日本正面臨著嚴重的經濟問題。
words.d: Severe means very bad or serious.

words.s: She stepped forward to shake his hand.
words.sz: 為了握住他的手，她往前跨了一步。
words.d: To shake is to move back and forth or up and down quickly.

words.s: My father has been in good shape since his operation.
words.sz: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。
words.d: An object’s shape is the arrangement of its sides and surfaces.

words.s: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
words.sz: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
words.d: To share something is to give some of it to another person.

words.s: The kitchen knife wasn't sharp enough to cut the meat, so I used my pocket knife.
words.sz: 这把菜刀不够锋利，所以我用了我的折叠刀来切肉。
words.d: A sharp object has a thin edge that cuts things easily.

words.s: Outside the school, she saw people with no homes living in cardboard boxes.
words.sz: 她在校外見到沒家的人住紙板箱。

words.s: If a man had 11 sheep and all but 9 died, how many sheep would he have left?
words.sz: 如果一个人有11只羊，除了9只之外，其他全部死了，那么他还剩下几只羊呢？

words.s: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
words.sz: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。
words.d: A shell is a hard covering that protects the body of some sea creatures.

words.s: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
words.sz: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
words.d: A shelter is a place to go that is safe from danger or bad weather.

words.s: The game will be played rain or shine.
words.sz: 無論颳風還是下雨，比賽都會繼續進行下去。
words.d: To shine is to make a bright light.

words.s: The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
words.sz: 這艘船逆風而行緩慢前進。

words.s: She got over the shock of her father's death.
words.sz: 她從她父親過世的震驚中恢復了。

words.s: There was some chewing gum stuck to the sole of Tom's shoe.
words.sz: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

words.s: My camera can shoot high-definition video.
words.sz: 我的录像机可以拍高清视频。
words.d: To shoot is to fire something like a bullet at someone or something.

words.s: When his food supply ran short, he had to look for a new place to live.
words.sz: 他的食物供给不足的的时候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。
words.d: A short thing is not long or not tall.

words.s: You should apologize to your father for not getting home in time for dinner.
words.sz: 你應該為你沒有及時回家吃晚餐向你父親道歉。

words.s: All at once she began to shout in a shrill voice.
words.sz: 突然間她開始用尖銳的聲音大喊。
words.d: To shout is to say something loudly.

words.s: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
words.sz: 人會因為體溫而在紅外線攝影機上顯現。

words.s: If a sick person folds one thousand paper cranes, her wish will come true.
words.sz: 如果一個病人折一千隻紙鶴,她的願望就會成真。

words.s: She is absent because of sickness.
words.sz: 她不在是因为病了。

words.s: Forks go to the left side of the plate, and knives go to the right.
words.sz: 叉子放在盤子的左邊，刀子放在右邊。

words.s: That sign over there says that swimming isn't allowed in this lake.
words.sz: 那邊那個牌子寫著這片湖裡禁止游泳。
words.d: A sign is an indication giving information, directions, a warning, etc.

words.s: He gave us the signal to begin.
words.sz: 他給了我們開始的信號。
words.d: A signal is a sound or action that tells someone to do something.

words.s: There was a minute of silence and then everybody started screaming.
words.sz: 有一分钟的沉默，然后每个人都开始尖叫。
words.d: Silence is the complete absence of sound or noise.

words.s: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
words.sz: 雄辯如銀，沉默如金。

words.s: He asked me questions similar to those asked by many others.
words.sz: 他和许多其他人一样问了我同样的问题。
words.d: Things which are similar are almost the same.

words.s: Because it is written in simple English even a child can understand it.
words.sz: 因為這是用簡單的英語寫的，所以甚至連孩子都能理解。

words.s: I've had a scratchy throat since this morning. I wonder if I've caught a cold.
words.sz: 早上起来，嗓子变得很沙哑，我想是不是感冒了。

words.s: Tom began to sing "Happy Birthday" and the entire restaurant joined in.
words.sz: 汤姆开始唱“祝你生日快乐”，然后整个餐厅的人都加入了进来。

words.s: Tom is single and has a three-year-old daughter.
words.sz: Tom單身，他有個三歲的女兒。
words.d: If something is single, then there is only one.

words.s: She put the dirty dishes in the sink.
words.sz: 她把脏盘子放进水池里。
words.d: To sink into something is to slowly fall into it.

words.s: I've never been to New York, and my sister hasn't, either.
words.sz: 我从没去过纽约，我妹妹也没有。

words.s: We moved our bags to make room for the elderly lady to sit down.
words.sz: 我們移走了行李騰出空間讓老太太可以坐下。

words.s: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
words.sz: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。

words.s: Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.
words.sz: 汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。

words.s: The explorers discovered a skeleton in the cave.
words.sz: 探险家们在洞穴里发现了骸骨。
words.d: A skeleton is all the bones of a body.

words.s: Fluency in English is a very marketable skill today.
words.sz: 流利的英語在今天是一種十分搶手的技能。
words.d: When you have skill at doing a job, you are good at doing it.

words.s: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
words.sz: 鯊魚皮比金槍魚皮粗糙多了。

words.s: Judging from the look of the sky, it may rain this afternoon.
words.sz: 從天色上判斷，今天下午可能會下雨。

words.s: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.
words.sz: 我拒绝被你像奴隶一样对待。

words.s: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
words.sz: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。
words.d: To sleep is to rest your mind and body, usually at night in bed.

words.s: The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
words.sz: 這艘船逆風而行緩慢前進。

words.s: On this small island are two large towns and many small settlements.
words.sz: 這個小島上有兩座大城市及許多小村鎮。

words.s: Jacob smashed the window with a rock.
words.d: To smash something is to break it into many small pieces.

words.s: I smell something burning in the kitchen.
words.sz: 我聞到廚房裡有東西燒焦了。
words.d: To smell something means to use your nose to sense it.

words.s: Sometimes I smoke just to give my hands something to do.
words.sz: 有时我吸烟只是因为要给我手头点事做。

words.s: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
words.sz: 將混合物攪拌均勻。
words.d: A smooth thing has no bumps or rough parts.

words.s: Because of heavy snow, the plane from Beijing arrived 20 minutes late.
words.sz: 由於下大雪，從北京来的班機延遲二十分鐘。

words.s: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
words.sz: 因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。

words.s: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
words.sz: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
words.d: If something is social, it is about many people in a community.

words.s: She was a tall, thin girl with long, soft brown hair.
words.sz: 她是個又高又瘦,留著一頭又長又軟的褐色頭髮的女孩。

words.s: The crash was and remains to date the deadliest airplane accident on Canadian soil.
words.sz: 這起空難是迄今為止加拿大境內最嚴重的空難。
words.d: Soil is the top layer of land on the Earth.

words.s: The soldier groaned with pain.
words.sz: 這名士兵痛苦地呻吟。

words.s: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
words.sz: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。

words.s: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
words.sz: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。
words.d: To solve something is to find an answer to it.

words.s: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
words.sz: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。

words.s: She was asked to convince him to get his son or someone else to paint the house.
words.sz: 她被要求去说服他以让他或者他的儿子或者是别的人来粉刷屋子。

words.s: Tom became popular among teenagers as soon as he made his debut on the screen.
words.sz: 汤姆第一次上电视后就广受青少年的欢迎。

words.s: He was always annoyed in the city by noises of one sort or another.
words.sz: 他在城市里一直受到噪音或者其他的干扰。
words.d: A sort of something is a type of it.

words.s: The only sound to be heard was the ticking of the clock.
words.sz: 唯一能听到的声音是钟的滴答声。
words.d: To sound means to make a noise.

words.s: Australia is smaller than South America.
words.sz: 澳洲比南美洲小。

words.s: The space race was an exciting time in history.
words.sz: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。
words.d: A space is an empty area.

words.s: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.
words.sz: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。

words.s: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
words.sz: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。
words.d: If something is special, it is unique and different.

words.s: The Prime Minister's speech was calculated to anger the opposition parties.
words.sz: 總理的發言估計激怒了在野黨。
words.d: A speech is something said to a group of people.

words.s: There are several ways to measure speed.
words.sz: 测速的方法有很多。
words.d: When you speed, you go very fast.

words.s: Money takes a long time to earn, but you can spend it in no time.
words.sz: 錢要花很長的時間來賺,但你可以一下子就花掉它了。

words.s: I spilled the coffee on the table.
words.d: To spill is to accidentally make something fall out of its container.

words.s: Let's split the reward fifty-fifty.
words.sz: 讓我們平分這個報酬吧。

words.s: Soccer is the most popular sport in Brazil.
words.sz: 足球在巴西是最受欢迎的运动。
words.d: Sport involves games like running, jumping, football, and tennis.

words.s: English has spread all over the country.
words.sz: 英語已經普及全國。
words.d: To spread is to move out to cover a larger area.

words.s: Do you know why spring rolls are called spring rolls?
words.sz: 你知道春卷为什么叫春卷吗？

words.s: One of them is a spy.
words.sz: 他們其中一人是間諜。

words.s: The area of the factory is 1,000 square meters.
words.sz: 工厂的面积是1000平方米。

words.s: Tom tried to stab me.
words.sz: 湯姆企圖刺我。

words.sz: 這班火車如此的擁擠以至於我整個車程都必須站著。
words.d: To stand is to use the legs and feet to hold the body upright.

words.s: The nearest star to our solar system is Proxima Centauri.
words.sz: 離我們太陽系最近的恆星是比鄰星。
words.d: A star is a bright shining thing in the night sky.

words.s: There are so many things to tell you that I don't know where to start.
words.sz: 我有太多話想和你說，以至於不知從何說起。

words.sz: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？
words.d: To starve is to not get enough food for a long period of time.

words.d: To state something means to say it in a definite way.

words.sz: 忠犬八公的雕像伫立在涩谷站前。

words.sz: 汤姆想待在家休息而不是和他的孩子们出去远足。

words.s: Can you teach me how to steal?
words.sz: 你能教我偷东西吗?

words.s: Water turns into steam when it is boiled.
words.sz: 水沸腾后变为蒸汽。

words.s: The new apartment building was made with steel.

words.s: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.
words.sz: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。

words.sz: 汤姆用棍子在沙上写了他的名字。

words.sz: 我和汤姆说过那样做很危险，但他还是想那样做。

words.sz: “滚石不生苔”是一句谚语。

words.sz: 首先，我要你跟我一起去百貨公司的特價活動。

words.sz: 我们的员工正在争分夺秒地修理冰暴带来的损坏。
words.d: A storm is very bad weather. There is a lot of rain or snow.

words.sz: 如果你想聽恐怖故事，那我就把幾個星期前作的夢告訴你吧。

words.sz: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。

words.sz: 沿着这条路直走，到第三个红绿灯的地方右转。

words.sz: 我們罷工是因為公司沒有改善我們的工資。
words.d: To strike people or things is to hit them.

words.sz: 很明顯的是這兩者之間有很強烈的分歧。

words.sz: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。

words.sz: 这是个很艰难的斗争。

words.sz: 我覺得，湯姆不會傻到那樣做。

words.sz: 你觉得他会对什么主题感兴趣？

words.d: A substance is a particular type of solid, liquid, or gas.

words.sz: 我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。
words.d: To succeed is to complete something as planned.

words.sz: 汤姆总是说话声音太小，我几乎听不懂他在说什么。

words.sz: 突然，敵人的炸彈像雨點一樣落向我們。

words.sz: 我无法忍受看着动物受苦。

words.sz: 我去炸一點紅薯，然後在上面撒上糖。

words.sz: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？

words.sz: 據報紙上說，他自殺了。

words.sz: 汤姆在夏休回乡看望父母。

words.sz: 即使太阳从西边出来，我也不会改变主意。

words.sz: 我不期望，他们能够支持我的观点。

words.sz: 假如你有1000美元，你会用它做什么呢？

words.s: She suppressed her urge to scream because she didn’t want to be noticed.
words.d: To suppress something means to prevent it from happening.

words.sz: 我很确定，汤姆是唯一能告诉我们我们需要知道的事情的人。

words.d: A surplus is an extra amount of something.

words.sz: 我們覺得很驚訝老虎隊竟然輸掉了比賽。

words.sz: 如果湯姆不投降，就開槍

words.sz: 每个人都对囚犯表示同情。

words.sz: 我很高興他們修復了暖氣系統，但現在太熱了。

words.sz: 筹划旅行的时候，我们必须考虑到全家人的意愿。

words.sz: 我不是小孩子，但有时你跟我说话就好像我是小孩子一样。

words.sz: 世界上任何山峰都达不到珠穆朗瑪峰的高度。

words.sz: 汽車油箱是滿的。

words.sz: 她的成功讓她受盡嫉妒。
words.d: To target is to aim an attack at someone or something.

words.s: You might not like this beer at first. It's an acquired taste.
words.sz: 剛開始的時候你可能不會喜歡這個啤酒。這是需要多次品嚐去習慣它的口味。

words.sz: 他想要减少进口品的税。

words.sz: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
words.d: A team is a group of people who work closely together.

words.sz: 现代科学技术让我们的生活更加舒适。

words.sz: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。

words.sz: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？
words.d: A telescope is a tool people use to look at the stars.

words.sz: 把我的電視機修好花了我一萬日元。

words.sz: 我很确定，汤姆是唯一能告诉我们我们需要知道的事情的人。

words.sz: 小孩的体温一般比大人的要高。
words.d: A temperature is a measure of how hot or cold something is.

words.sz: 正式工比临时工要好。
words.d: If something is temporary, it exists for a short time.

words.s: The situation seemed very tense and dangerous.
words.sz: 形势似乎非常紧张严峻。

words.sz: 这个学期我们有两次考试。
words.d: A term is a word for something.

words.sz: Tom写作可以写的像本国人一样，可是他的发音很烂

words.sz: 军队占领了整片领土。

words.sz: 我痛恨恐怖主义组织。

words.sz: 汤姆考试时没时间答完所有题。

words.sz: 倫敦的人口遠遠多於其他英國城市的人口。

words.sz: 谢谢你在我贫困潦倒之时借给我$500。

words.sz: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。

words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

words.sz: 我想去美術館勝過去電影院。

words.sz: 比起少抽菸，你何不直接把菸戒了？

words.d: Wood is the thing that trees are made of.

words.s: I didn't know the city, and what's more, I couldn't speak a word of the language.
words.sz: 我不知道这个城市，而且我一点都不懂那里的语言。

words.s: It would take me too much time to explain to you why it's not going to work.
words.sz: 给你解释这为什么行不通要花很多时间。
words.d: To work is to do a job that you get paid for.

words.s: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.
words.sz: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。
words.d: The world is the Earth and all the people and things in it.

words.s: Don't worry! Even if I drink, it doesn't have an effect on my driving.
words.sz: 別擔心!即使我喝酒了,它對我的駕駛沒有影響。

words.s: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.
words.sz: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。
words.d: If something is worse, it is of poorer quality than another thing.

words.s: If you enjoy the work you do, you have something worth more than money.
words.sz: 如果你喜歡你做的工作，你就有比金錢更有價值的東西。
words.d: If something is worth an amount of money, it costs that amount.

words.s: He cleansed the wound before putting on a bandage.
words.sz: 他先清洗了伤口，再绑上绷带。
words.d: To wound is to injure someone or something by cutting or breaking the skin.

words.s: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.
words.sz: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。
words.d: To wreck something means to destroy or ruin it.

words.s: Tom can write almost like a native speaker, but his pronunciation is terrible.
words.sz: Tom写作可以写的像本国人一样，可是他的发音很烂
words.d: To write is to use a pen or keyboard to make letters and numbers on paper or a screen.

words.s: It's wrong to deceive people, but worse to deceive yourself.
words.sz: 欺騙別人是錯的,但更糟的欺騙自己。

words.s: Do you know how many people in the world starve to death every year?
words.sz: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？
words.d: A year is a period of 365 days or twelve months.

words.s: These green leaves turn red or yellow in autumn.
words.sz: 这些绿叶到秋天变成红色或黄色。

words.s: "Shall I have him call you when he gets back?" "Yes, please."
words.sz: “等他回来，我要让他给你打电话吗？”“是的，谢谢。”

words.s: I can't remember the meaning of the word that I looked up yesterday.
words.sz: 我记不起昨天查的那个词的意思了。

words.s: I haven't yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
words.sz: 我還沒有收集到足夠的材料來寫一本書。
words.d: Yet is used to say something has not happened up to now.

words.s: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.
words.sz: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。

words.s: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
words.sz: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。

words.s: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
words.sz: 水在攝氏零度時結冰。

words.s: Do you remember the time you and I went to the zoo together when you and I were in elementary school?
words.sz: 你还记得我们还在小学时你和我一起去动物园那次吗？
